name: DS_ARA_CACHE
meaning: the cache folder the plugin writes below (default ~/Library/Caches/DrumSpike/ARA)

name: DS_ARA_OUT
meaning: where the plugin writes its report, one JSON object per line

name: DS_ARA_DEPS
meaning: check.sh only: the folder of the third-party parts (default .deps)

name: DS_ARA_TESTHOST
meaning: check.sh only: the ARATestHost binary of the conformance stage

name: DS_ARA_FAULT
meaning: the analysis runs inside process on purpose, so the overrun check can fail

name: DS_ARA_TABLES_FAULT
meaning: the plugin serves a document controller table with one emptied slot

name: DS_ARA_RESTORE_FAULT
values: decode, newid, empty, late-events, result, no-repair, unknown-same
meaning: the restore decodes one source, ignores the stored id, drops the stored events, sets the events of the document on the worker thread, or counts a source that the archive holds with no result as done (the way before #572: it is never analysed), or (F6, #582) does not point the record of a restored track at the new cache file when its audio is read (the track stays offline (changed)), or (F6, M1) counts a content that nobody compared (no hash and no sample count in the archive) as the same audio

name: DS_ARA_SERVICE_FAULT
meaning: a new service for every job (the M1a way)

name: DS_ARA_TRACKS_FAULT
meaning: a later request forgets the earlier tracks

name: DS_ARA_FOLDER_FAULT
meaning: every document uses one folder

name: DS_ARA_DESTROY_FAULT
meaning: a destroyed source stays in the list and the project

name: DS_ARA_HOME_FAULT
meaning: the service home is below the user's home, outside the cache folder

name: DS_ARA_ROUND_FAULT
values: new-only, always, no-deadline, no-late-round, no-page-wait, request-only, ready-only, read-again, ignore-update, no-retry, retry-forever, force-failed, no-spawn-failed, clear-stale, no-read-retry, keep-wavs, clear-failed, cancel-fails, events-late, publish-delay
meaning: a round analyses only the new tracks, a request for a complete source starts a full round, a request waits for ever for audio that does not come, or audio that comes after the deadline starts no round; request-only: a round starts only on a request of the host (the plugin before M1b4: LUNA never asks, so it got no round); ready-only: a source is queued only when its audio is here, so sources whose audio comes one after the other get a round each; read-again: the read of a source that has its result (one restored from an archive) starts a round; ignore-update: updateAudioSourceContent does nothing (new samples of a source are never read or analysed); no-retry: a failed round is not tried again by the plugin; retry-forever: it never gives up; force-failed: a source whose read was cancelled forces a round of the complete tracks; no-spawn-failed: a reader thread that cannot start leaves its source waiting for the audio deadline; clear-stale: a round on the old audio marks the new audio of a content update as analysed; no-read-retry: a failed read of new audio is not tried again; keep-wavs: the WAV files of a destroyed source stay; clear-failed: a round on the old audio clears the failed mark of a source whose new read failed for good (it stays incomplete for ever); cancel-fails: a read that a content update cancelled counts as a failed read; no-page-wait: a round or a removal does not wait for a job of the page: the round fails with its 409 and a failed removal wipes the events of the document; events-late (F5): a round sets the events of the document after the notes of its sources, with no lock held between (the way before #572: a store in that window wrote all notes and no event); publish-delay: the publication of a round waits 200 ms after each source (100 ms with events-late) to widen that window

name: DS_ARA_SETTLE_FAULT
meaning: no settle time: every request is a round

name: DS_ARA_CLOSE_FAULT
meaning: the destroy of a controller waits for the round, or does not cancel it

name: DS_ARA_ID_FAULT
meaning: the plugin trusts the document id and the track names of an archive, and the names of the host sources

name: DS_ARA_REGISTRY_FAULT
meaning: no registry of the document ids in use: two live documents may share one

name: DS_ARA_ERRORS_FAULT
meaning: the error of a single track is not read

name: DS_ARA_RETRY_FAULT
meaning: a retried source makes a second track

name: DS_ARA_TOUCH_FAULT
meaning: a change of the regions or the properties of a source is not seen, or a move in playback time alone starts a round

name: DS_ARA_GUARD_FAULT
meaning: the reader thread and the worker thread run without the panic guard

name: DS_ARA_UNLOAD_FAULT
meaning: the unload of the library does not stop the worker

name: DS_ARA_PANIC_TEST
meaning: the reader thread or the worker thread panics once

name: DS_ARA_SCENARIO
values: corrupt-wav:<n>, fail-first-round, slow-setup, audio-deadline-ms:<n>, fail-rounds:<n>, no-reader-thread
meaning: the WAV of source n is damaged after the read, the first round fails once, every round waits 1.5 s before its analysis starts, or a request waits n ms for audio (default 30000); fail-rounds:<n>: the first n rounds fail; no-reader-thread: the reader thread of a source cannot start

name: DS_ARA_RETRY_MS
meaning: the first wait of the automatic retry of a failed round (default 2000, then twice as long each time; kept between 10 and 60000)

name: DS_ARA_STATE_FAULT
meaning: strict: the load of the plugin state refuses an empty stream, a newer version and anything else than its own blob (the host's instance creation then fails, as in LUNA); no-rows: a call of the host to the state is not written to the report

name: DS_ARA_EDITOR_MODE
values: ready, keys, focus, resize, measure, edit, shell, analyse, net, bigpost, transport, playback, hit, menu, geometry, names, hostkeys, delivery, selection, exportdialog, leftovers
meaning: the editor page runs a test driver of that name and reports to the plugin (the test host sets it itself); transport: the page samples its drawn position while the host plays a transport script; playback: the page does play, stop and locate like a user and the host records what it is asked; hit: the host sends the double click of a pointer into the lane of two tracks and the page reports the pixels of both lanes before and after; menu: the page uses its menu button of the host mode with the pointer and the keyboard, in a normal and a low window; geometry: the page reports the rows that its lines span after a change of the zoom, the track height and the window size; names: the page reports the display names of the tracks, the host renames a DAW track and moves a region, the page reports againthe editor page runs a test driver of that name and reports to the plugin (the test host sets it itself); hostkeys: the host posts real key events to its window and records every one that reaches it, the page records what it saw of each; delivery: the page exports in song time, uses the folder rule and starts a file drag, and reports what each call answered; selection (M1b13): the host sends a list of selections and hide lists through the ARA editor view and the page reports what it shows after each (the selected track, the marks, the range band, the view, the hidden rows), with a pointer, a key and the menu switch of the page; exportdialog (M1c2): the page opens the Export dialog from the menu (File > Export...), drags a tile, exports, closes and opens it again, chooses the folder of DS_ARA_PICK_DIR (the argument) and exports again, and reports what the dialog showed; leftovers (M1d1): the page reports every text that names a track, the dirty dot and the export dialog; the host then replaces the audio of one source and the page reports its status line after the reload

name: DS_ARA_EDITOR_ARG
meaning: the argument of the test driver of the editor page (a WAV path of the shell mode)

name: DS_ARA_EDITOR_FAULT
values: no-ready, no-bundle, no-shell, no-sync, no-record, no-notes, no-reload, no-events, drop-edits, drop-track-data, missing-function, allow-track-set, no-focus, no-resize, inline, leak, slow-frames, page-transport, no-color, stale-geometry, no-menu, keys-pass, no-shield, no-monitor, no-click-out, old-freshness, no-forward-modifier, rect-inside, no-repeat-guard, no-field-undo, swallow-actions, fixed-class-name, no-system-keys, no-key-text, any-dest, prefix-dest, any-path, no-button-check, sel-no-guard, sel-own-range, sel-no-scroll, sel-no-switch, sel-no-note, sel-user-loses, old-dest, no-remember, test-row-real, left-key, left-dot, left-dest
meaning: the editor: the page's ready call is not counted, the plugin finds no page in its bundle, the shell commands are left to the service, a command of the page does not reach the archive or the request thread does not record it before the page's answer (no-record), the notes do not follow an edit, the page is not told that a round ended or gets no event of the service, a round of the plugin drops the hand edits of the page, the shell script of the page finds a function missing (it reports it), a region change drops the hand data of the track (hits, role, mix), the page may change the track set, the web view is not the first responder or does not follow a resize, a command runs on the main thread, every editor leaks 4 MB, the page draws slow frames, (page-transport) the page runs a command of the app's own transport, (no-color) the tracks have no colour and the page has no repair, (stale-geometry) the page keeps the key of the sizes that it had before #559, so the lines of a row with its own height are not drawn again, or (no-menu) the page has no menu button; keys (M1b12): (keys-pass) the key rule is off: nothing takes a key, every key goes on to the host, (no-shield) the key shield passes an unused key on to the host, (no-monitor) the monitor of key equivalents is off: a key with Command, Control or Option goes to the host's menu first, (no-click-out) a click outside the plugin does not take the first responder from the web view, (old-freshness) the answers of WebKit to a key count only for 0.25 s from the creation of the event (round 2), (no-forward-modifier) the plugin takes a key up and a change of the modifier keys without giving them to the host, (rect-inside) a click counts as inside the plugin by the rectangle of the shield, not by the view it lands on, (no-repeat-guard) a held space bar repeats its key down to the page, (no-field-undo) Cmd+Z in a text field does not undo, (swallow-actions) the shield answers every menu action of the host, (fixed-class-name) the key shield class has one fixed name (a second copy of the plugin cannot make it), (no-system-keys) the shield takes the system keys too, or (no-key-text) the page does not show the text of an absent command's key; (M1c1) any-dest: a dest outside the document folder is written without the folder chosen in the sheet, prefix-dest: a subfolder of a chosen folder passes as a dest, any-path: a file drag takes a path outside Exports/, no-button-check: the drag starts with no mouse button down; (M1b13) sel-no-guard: the page overwrites its selection while a pointer or key action runs, sel-own-range: the range of the host is the page's own hit selection, sel-no-scroll: nothing scrolls the view to the range or the selected track into view, sel-no-switch: the switch of the menu does not stop the follow, sel-no-note: the hidden rows have no text, sel-user-loses: the page cannot tell that the user changed the selection during an action; (M1c2) old-dest: the default export folder of the document is refused as a dest like any other folder (the rule before #579), no-remember: the folder chosen in the sheet is not kept for the document, test-row-real (round 3): the row drag_started says session real in a gate run (only the row; no system session starts); (M1d1) left-key: the label helper of the page returns the key of a track, so a text shows the machine name and not the name of the DAW track; left-dot: the unsaved dot shows in a DAW; left-dest: the destination row of the export dialog is not collapsed

name: DS_ARA_TRANSPORT_FAULT
meaning: the host transport of the page (M1b5): off: the audio thread stores no transport, so the page never follows; flood: a message to the page every 8 ms instead of every 40 ms; invent: with no transport seen, the page is told the host plays from 0; alloc: the audio thread allocates in its call (the unit test that names the hand-over fails); keep-playing: a cleared slot or a host with no position does not stop the page (the way before review round 3)

name: DS_ARA_PLAYBACK_FAULT
values: direct, skip, anonymous, error-row, no-fallback, no-supersede, no-drag-guard, keep-error
meaning: the page moves the host (M1b7): direct: the request thread calls the ARA playback controller itself, not the main thread; skip: the plugin makes no call to the host and says it did; anonymous: the text of a missing control does not name the host; error-row: a refused request of the page is an error (an error row is written); no-fallback: the shell never shows the host position again after a request the host did not follow, and Play ends at once; no-supersede: every locate of the queue of host requests runs, none is dropped for a newer one; no-drag-guard: the shell shows the host position again under the pointer of a drag; keep-error: the text of a failed play stays when the host starts later

name: DS_ARA_NAMES_FAULT
values: ignore, region-first, no-number, no-rename, no-reload, round, key, role-source, role-hand, role-frozen, restore-guess
meaning: the names of the tracks (M1b10): role-source: the role guess reads the name of the audio source only, not the name of the DAW track; role-hand: a new DAW name overwrites a role the user set; role-frozen: the role is guessed once and never again; restore-guess: a restore of the archive guesses the role again and drops the settings of the user; ignore: the names of the host are ignored and the page shows the track key; region-first: the name of a playback region wins over the name of its region sequence; no-number: two tracks with one DAW name show one name; no-rename: updateRegionSequenceProperties is ignored; no-reload: a rename or a move does not tell the page; round: a rename or a move starts an analysis round; key: the key of a track follows the name of the DAW track (the identity of a track must not)

name: DS_ARA_EDITOR_SCENARIO
meaning: rm-exports (M1c2): the first export command of the page finds no Exports/ in the project of the document (the empty folder is removed once); the named command of the page panics inside the plugin where the service would run it, or the worker hears 12 s late about a change of the page (the request thread's own record is not delayed)

name: DS_ARA_DELIVERY_FAULT
meaning: the export of M1c1: source-time: the files keep the time of the source (no region mapping), stale-regions: the song position of a region is the one of the last analysis round, not the live one (a clip moved in the host exports at its old place), invent-map: the plugin makes up a tempo map the host did not give; keep-reader: the plugin does not give the content reader of the host's musical context back

name: DS_ARA_SELECTION_FAULT
values: no-track, no-others, no-hidden, unknown-clears, keep-range, no-pull, no-throttle, no-row, round
meaning: the selection of the DAW (M1b13): no-track: the page is never given the track; no-others: only the first track is given, the others are not marked; no-hidden: the hidden tracks are ignored; unknown-clears: a selection of a DAW track with no source of the plugin clears the range of the page; keep-range: an empty selection is not passed on, so the range stays; no-pull: a page that opens after the host selected something is told nothing of it (it sees only the events that come later); no-throttle: every change is sent to the page at once and written as a report row (no gate of 50 ms and one row a second); no-row: the report row of a selection has the counts only; round: a selection of the host starts an analysis round

name: DS_ARA_LEFTOVER_FAULT
meaning: (M1d1) no-audio-reason: a round that read new audio of the host names no track in its page event and its job row, so the page cannot say that the DAW changed the audio

name: DS_ARA_PICK_DIR
meaning: the folder sheet of the plugin answers with this folder (or cancel) without showing: the test host has no hand to click it

name: DS_ARA_DRAG_PRESSED
meaning: the file drag acts as if the left mouse button is down: the test host has no real mouse. A gate run never starts a system drag session: the plugin writes the items to a private pasteboard (DS_ARA_DRAG_TEST=1 or the test host's editor mode)

name: DS_ARA_DRAG_TEST
meaning: the file drag makes its items on a private pasteboard and starts no system drag session (an editor run of the test host implies it)

name: DS_ARA_SONG_FAULT
values: round-regions, source-x, no-cut-start, home-only, store-song, selected-track, leak
meaning: the page in song time (M1b8): round-regions: the rows of the page are made from the regions of the last analysis round, not from the live ones (a clip moved in the host is not seen); the other values are made by the test driver in the page: source-x: the page draws the hits in source time, not in song time; no-cut-start: the mapping ignores where a clip starts in its source; home-only: the page draws only the first source of a DAW track and a setting reaches only that source; store-song: a hit the page adds is stored with its song time, not its source time; selected-track: the page maps the position of the host through the first clip of the selected row (the way of #554); leak: the song-time mode is on without the host-mode switch of the page (the standalone page must not change)

name: DS_ARA_PREPARE_FAULT
values: per-source, stale-ok, all-rows, two-tracks, forever, no-watchdog, no-refresh, raw-name, no-debounce, user-file, link-exports, no-file-numbering, late-row, fp-no-name, no-held-check, no-hard-link
meaning: the prepared files of M1c3 (several, separated by commas): per-source: one file per source, as the dialog makes them; stale-ok: a take ignores the state of the hits (an old set is taken); all-rows: every row is made again after an edit in one row; two-tracks: the merged MIDI file has one track per drum; forever: a job never ends; no-watchdog: the handle stays preparing for ever; no-refresh: the follower refresh of the preparation is skipped; raw-name: the DAW track name goes into the file name as it is; no-debounce: no quiet time; user-file (a scenario): a file of the user with known bytes lies in Exports/ under a row's MIDI name before the first set is made; link-exports: the old behaviour, the worker links its file into Exports/ and replaces a file of the user; no-file-numbering: two sets with one file name are not numbered; late-row (a scenario): the row 'Snare_audio' shows only after the first take; fp-no-name: the final file name is not part of fp; no-held-check: a job may overwrite the prepared file of another set; no-hard-link: a take cannot link, it copies

name: DS_ARA_PREPARE_WAIT_MS
meaning: the watchdog of the prepared files (default 30000): how long a handle may stay preparing before it says error

name: DS_ARA_PREPARE_QUIET_MS
meaning: the quiet time before the MIDI files are made again after a change (default 800; the wav kinds wait three times as long)

name: DS_ARA_PREPARE_TRACE
meaning: the preparation writes a report row prepare_wake (file and line of the caller, time) for each wake of its worker

name: DS_ARA_DEFAULTS_FAULT
meaning: (#577) lose-kept: the settings that the archive holds for a source with no result are dropped in its first round (the way of main before #577)
